def player_pos():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and 20<n['pixels']<30:
            b=n['boundary']
            return (min(p[0] for p in b), min(p[1] for p in b))
def redcount():
    return sum(r.count('R') for r in current_frame.ascii.split('\n'))
print('start', player_pos(), 'red', redcount())
# phase 1: to (32,14)
res = action(['DOWN']*4)
print('after down4', player_pos(), 'red', redcount(), 'changed', last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
# phase 2: spam DOWN until we pass to (38,14)

    r = action(['DOWN'])
    p = player_pos()
    rc = redcount()
    if p == (38,14):
        print('PASSED at attempt', k+1, 'red', rc)
        break
    if last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print('STOP: done/game_over', last_action_result)
        break
    if k % 5 == 4:
        print('  still waiting', k+1, p, 'red', rc)
else:
    print('never passed, at', player_pos())
    raise SystemExit
# phase 3: continue down and right to goal
res = action(['DOWN','DOWN'])
print('after down2', player_pos(), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('done'))
res = action(['RIGHT']*6)
print('final', player_pos(), 'res', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','game_over','done','run_complete')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
